title: Normalize Gis Plugin Crate To Consistency Contract
description: Normalize gis/plugin/rs (Gis2dPlayApp/Gis3dPlayApp, pub mod app_2d/app_3d) to the Consistency Contract: adopt SDK PanelKit (tree_item/tree_item_with_action/PanelTreeBuilder/selection_ids) from semio_framework_plugin, adopt Terminology (app_labels!/LocaleLabels/localized_label_map/AppLabelsOverlayExt) replacing hand-rolled Labels struct+resolver, verify .resource_kind() on AppBuilder chains, confirm C1 app struct naming, fix C2/C3 region markers/order (rename registration region to 🔖️Manifest, tests region to 🧪️Tests, canonical order Constants->Types->DocumentHelpers->Terminology->CommandLabels->Panels->Render->App impls->Manifest->Tests), keep C4 pub mod app_2d/app_3d layout, adopt Testkit (testkit::meta/new_app/new_app_with_registry/paired_apps/assert_undo_redo_round_trip/assert_two_instances_converge/assert_ingest_idempotent) replacing local scaffolding and generic test bodies while leaving GisMapDocument/GisMapDiff/GisMapOp/MapFeature domain module substance and app-unique tests untouched.
summary: Normalized gis/plugin/rs/lib.rs to the Consistency Contract. Adopted semio_framework_plugin's PanelKit (tree_item_with_action/PanelTreeBuilder/selection_ids), Terminology (app_labels!/LocaleLabels/resolve_labels/is_de_locale/localized_label_map/AppLabelsOverlayExt), and Testkit (testkit::meta/new_app/new_app_with_registry/assert_two_instances_converge) primitives in both app_2d (Gis2dPlayApp) and app_3d (Gis3dPlayApp) submodules, deleting all local hand-rolled equivalents. Reordered every region into canonical order (Constants -> Types -> DocumentHelpers -> Terminology -> CommandLabels -> Panels -> Render -> App impl -> Manifest -> Tests) and renamed both apps' "AppFactory" registration regions to "Manifest" (matching the established trinity/process precedent of keeping the crate-level "Bundle" region separate for the semio_plugin! macro). Fixed pre-existing region-marker format violations in the domain module (space-after-// on 4 markers, a missing emoji on one). C1 app-struct naming (Gis2dPlayApp/Gis3dPlayApp) and C4 pub-mod-per-app layout were already correct and left as-is. gis2d's resource_kind declaration was confirmed correct; gis3d correctly has none (it registers no OS export/import handlers, matching the pattern in every other resource_kind-bearing app crate).
